// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.14

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns a list of objects attached to the given object.

|s1= [[attachedObjects]] obj

|p1= obj: [[Object]] - given object

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Object]]s attached to the given object

|x1= <sqf>
{ detach _x } forEach attachedObjects player;
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
if (count attachedObjects player == 0) then
{
	hint "There are no objects attached to player";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[attachObject]] [[attachTo]] [[attachedTo]] [[waypointAttachVehicle]] [[waypointAttachedVehicle]] [[lightAttachObject]] [[triggerAttachVehicle]] [[attachedObject]] [[detach]]
}}
